articles.summary: eHealth (Nasdaq: EHTH), a leading private online health insurance marketplace, today announced it has been certified by Great Place To Work® (GPTW) for the third consecutive year. The recognition is based entirely on feedback from employees about their experience working at eHealth. In this year's survey, 86% of employee respondents said eHealth is a great place to work, compared to 57% of employees at a typical U.S.-based company, according to GPTW. Great Place To Work® is the global authority on workplace culture, employee experience, and the leadership behaviors proven to deliver market-leading revenue, employee retention, and increased innovation. "Great Place To Work Certification is a highly coveted achievement that requires consistent and intentional dedication to the overall employee experience," says Sarah Lewis-Kulin, the Vice President of Global Recognition at Great Place To Work. articles.summary: eHealth (Nasdaq: EHTH), a leading private online health insurance marketplace, today announced the launch of Content Genius , its AI-powered platform that streamlines how the company gathers, validates, and publishes the details for thousands of Medicare Advantage plans from dozens of insurers. Content Genius replaces a manual model with an AI-powered automated process, enabling eHealth to more quickly and efficiently gather important Medicare Advantage plan details, including benefits, care provider networks, and prescription medication formularies. Rather than manually reviewing every insurer-provided file, which often comes through different channels and formats (emails, PDFs, spreadsheets, etc.), Content Genius helps automate a historically costly and time-intensive process.
